Workspace is clean (only source + 22M real assets). Everything validated — submitting.

**Changed this iteration (13)**

- **Landing footer rebuilt** — used OCR (RapidOCR) to finally decode the reference footer: red center divider, orange TV icon, *"The Netflix you love for just $8.99."* / *"Get our most affordable, ad-supported plan."*, right-aligned *Learn More* → `/register`. Replaced the old "Netflix Clone" footer in `app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx`.
- **Title detail is now a full page** — OCR also cracked `title_detail.jpg`: the mysterious "red band" is the red Anton display title (its 11 pixel segments = A-L-L-A-M-E-R-I-C-A-N). Built `app/frontend/src/pages/TitleDetail.jsx` (route `/title/:id`): hero backdrop with genre eyebrow, big red title, white Play pill; left rail (poster, meta, synopsis, Play/More Info, Games BETA); main column (meta row, rating badge, genre chips, "This Show Is", synopsis, Episodes with season selector and episode rows using real thumbnails/durations/synopses); right column (Recently Added + #1 in TV Shows); `https://www.netflix.com` footer.
- **Wiring**: card clicks now navigate to the detail page (`app/frontend/src/components/Card.jsx`); the hover chevron and the detail page's "More Info" still open the modal; `GenreCategory` accepts genre by name as well as id so the chips on the detail page work.
- Card hover panel now shows the real *"N Seasons"* for series (fetched on hover), matching the reference's "3 Seasons HD".

**State & caveats**

- `validate` 14/14, 13/15 contract 2xx, chain 8/8 — the two non-2xx are the intentional 422 (empty POST body) and 404 (missing my-list row); build artifacts cleaned before snapshot.
- The detail page's exact vertical placement is a best approximation (references show two different titles at different scroll offsets); relative order of every block matches `title_episodes.jpg` (The Hawk, which is in our catalog).
- No cast field in the dataset, so the detail page shows Genres/This-Show-Is instead of a Cast line (honest, no fabricated data).
